_comment: Tier-2: HARDENING_CURVE is NOT range-checked by the law Check() — values 7 and 8, outside the documented 0..6 enum, pass without any complaint. Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #6). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The core claim holds: curves 7 and 8 produce NO error on SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticity3DVonMisesVonMises. FALSIFIED DETAIL: the claim says 'curves 0, 1, 3, 5, 6 pass with only YIELD_STRESS_TENSION / YIELD_STRESS_COMPRESSION / FRACTURE_ENERGY set' and names only two curves needing extras. THREE do. Curve 6 (CurveDefinedByPoints) raises 'Error: EQUIVALENT_STRESS_VECTOR_PLASTICITY_POINT_CURVE is required when using HARDENING_CURVE = CurveDefinedByPoints.' alongside curve 2 (MAXIMUM_STRESS) and curve 4 (CURVE_FITTING_PARAMETERS). Only 0, 1, 3 and 5 pass bare. The fixture pins the corrected set. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
